headline: French sociologist, philosopher and intellectual provocateur Edgar Morin has died aged 104
subhead: Committed to connecting different fields of knowledge to develop his 'complex thought,' this former member of the Resistance and deeply humanist intellectual advocated for a revolution of consciousness. He died in Paris on Friday, his wife confirmed to Le Monde.

France heatwave sparks calls for more supervision at swimming areas after multiple drownings
subhead: At least eight people have died by drowning in recent days. While some municipalities are trying to adapt their supervision and safety measures, many lack the capacity, given the number of locations involved – which are not always authorized for swimming – and the shortage of lifeguards.

headline: In Chongqing, China, the 'bangbang' porters are no longer in demand
subhead: These iconic workers in the vast, mountainous city have long been employed to carry goods through its steep alleyways. But modernization is making their once-essential role obsolete.

headline: The little-known story of Bella Ariel, a Lanvin model murdered at Auschwitz
subhead: Journalist and author Arnaud Nemet tells the story of his great-grand-aunt, Bella Ariel, a celebrated 1930s model whose life was both dazzling and tragic. A Jewish immigrant from Constantinople, she was arrested after a denunciation and murdered at Auschwitz-Birkenau at 31.

headline: French Open 2026: Moïse Kouamé's meteoric rise
subhead: Poised for greatness, the 17-year-old French player has won his first two matches at the Paris Grand Slam and faces Chilean Alejandro Tabilo on Saturday in the third round. It is a spectacular ascent for a player already recognized as a young phenomenon.
